unit.target: Cargo target.<triple>.<links> override effect on build-script compilation and build-dependencies
unit.finding: For normal Cargo compilation dependency-graph construction, a links override does more than suppress the build-script process. Cargo still returns a RunCustomBuild unit for the package, but compute_deps_custom_build returns an empty dependency list when the package links key has a matching override. Cargo's own dep_build_script comment states that an overridden build script's run unit has no dependencies while the unit of work is still returned. The normal, non-overridden RunCustomBuild path depends on the CustomBuild compilation unit, which recursively pulls build-dependencies. With the override, that dependency edge is absent, so the build-script compilation unit and its build-dependencies are not reached through this build-script path and therefore are not compiled through that path. In custom_build::prepare, preinserted override output selects fingerprint::prepare_target rather than build_work, so the build-script executable is not run.
evidence_detail: unit_dependencies.rs: compute_deps_custom_build checks manifest links against unit.links_overrides and immediately returns an empty Vec, with the source comment that overridden build scripts have no dependencies.

unit_dependencies.rs: dep_build_script documents that override removes dependencies of the running build-script unit but still returns a unit of work; None is reserved for packages with no build script.

custom_build.rs: normal model has a build-script execution unit depending on the build-script compilation unit; prepare detects already-populated override output and uses fingerprint preparation instead of build_work.
unit.verified_scope: Static inspection of current public Cargo source at commit 8814ead110e36ed8fdcf1fdd4009baf82bd78523 for normal dependency-graph construction and overridden RunCustomBuild preparation; no Cargo execution was performed.
unit.not_verified_scope: No end-to-end cargo build test, no assertion for every command mode, no specific crate, no guarantee for independently-rooted CustomBuild units (for example aggressive clean-related graph generation), no native/generated artifact availability, no parser-version portability proof.
unit.scope_guard: Do not generalize this source-level normal-build result into a claim that CustomBuild units can never appear under any Cargo command, or that links overrides replace native/generated artifacts or every build-script side effect.

exact_continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and SHA-only validate current authority, then run one bounded official Cargo testsuite/source leaf to look for a test that demonstrates whether a target.<triple>.<links> override prevents compilation of the build.rs target and its build-dependencies in an actual cargo build. If no direct test exists, record that exact absence and identify the smallest public reproducible test fixture without executing Cargo. Keep native/generated artifacts, specific-crate correctness and broader command modes unresolved; do not start a second leaf.
